Mapping: Find bursts -> Run (and the hub's Next); Save bursts -> Save .bur / Export .bur; To ndX -> Open in ndX (and step 7); Algorithm / Sliding window parameters / Photons/window (m) / Min photons (L) / Window dur (T ms) / Macrotime interval (dMT) / use min/max dMT / Merge gap -> the 'Burst search' form from tttrlib's parameter schema plus 'Macro time interval' (Use min dT, Use max dT, Fill gaps, Merge gap) and 'Filter' (Min photons); Detector channel / Routing channels All / Micro-time window / Microtime range full decay -> 'Channel selection' (Detector, Micro-time window); Display layers -> 'Display' (All photons, Selected photons); MCS intensity trace -> Count rate; Inter-photon delay (dt) -> Inter-photon time; Microtime decay (TCSPC) -> Micro-time decay; 1D feature histogram / 2D feature scatter (with gating) / X feature / Y feature -> Histogram, Scatter (X, Y); Summary metrics -> Summary; Selected bursts -> Bursts; Recompute -> Refresh plots / Restart; Files channels -> Files; Help reference -> Help. Rate cutoff (kHz) / Threshold background / Subtract background: the background is measured in step 5 and subtracted where E and S are computed (Accurate FRET's background fields, ndX's equations), not typed into the search. Static FRET line: the E-S map of step 7 (ndX Overlays tab) draws the FRET lines. Numbers (49.5-50.5, 0.45-0.75, x_min/x_max, 60, 0.1500, 1.0 ms, 50.0 kHz) are the legacy app's empty-plot ticks and field defaults, data not controls; the empty messages '(No TTTR file loaded...)' / '(No bursts detected...)' / 'No files loaded' are the native app's 'Add TTTR files and choose a detector setup' / 'No burst table yet' lines.
